facts.fact: The NIMC director general says banks, telecom operators, insurance companies and fintechs already authenticate customers through NIMC's real-time verification platform by matching fingerprint or face against the NIN record; a bank digital officer confirms onboarding verifies identity against the national database.
facts.system: NIMC real-time verification platform (NIN authentication platform)

facts.fact: NIMC says agencies for taxation, immigration, education, healthcare, security, aviation and social intervention rely on the NIN alongside banks and telecoms; the newspaper itself says the NIN enables verification across banking, telecommunications and immigration, while experts say adoption is uneven and updates are not automatic.
facts.system: NIMC real-time verification platform (NIN authentication platform)
